steps.body: In the tens count, every number has a next: after 30 comes 40, after 70 comes 80.
steps.narration: In the tens count, every number has a next: after 30 comes 40, after 70 comes 80.

widget.prompt: Which ten comes after 40? Hop one ten and tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: That adds just one. Counting by TENS adds a whole ten: 50.
That goes back a ten. Counting forward gives 50.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 40 and count on one: you land on 50.

predict.prompt: One tens-hop from 40 — how far will you land?
predict.reveal: A tens-hop is one BIG jump of ten: 40 lands on 50, skipping all nine numbers between.
